Canadian Banks Pledge Over $200 Billion for Infrastructure and Expansion

Two major Canadian banks, Scotiabank and TD Bank, have announced significant financial commitments to support the expansion of Canadian companies and infrastructure development. Scotiabank pledged more than $100 billion, while TD Bank committed over $108 billion. These funds are intended to fuel growth and infrastructure projects within Canada.
